entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I'm offering my help in exchange f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm offering my help in exchange for a position in the cabinet. As the Minister of Law and Justice in the next term."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""You know I have both the expertise..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know I have both the expertise and the influence. It's a huge offer, Mr. President. For both of us."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I think you'd also agree that Mrs...."
entries.dialogueText: "I think you'd also agree that Mrs. Morgna isn't doing much to justify the retainment of her position."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't like this offer, Mr. Garac..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't like this offer, Mr. Garaci. I need something better than that."
entries.menuText: "I don't like this offer, Mr. Garaci. I need something better than that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't know if I can trust you mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know if I can trust you more than Mrs. Morgna."
entries.menuText: "I don't know if I can trust you more than Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I think it's mutually beneficial.""

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""I'll show you my influence and my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll show you my influence and my reliability at the vote as long as you can promise me that."

entries.speaker: Heron Garaci
entries.title: Heron Garaci: ""So... What do you say, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... What do you say, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's a deal. I'll make you the nex..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a deal. I'll make you the next minister of justice."
entries.menuText: "It's a deal. I'll make you the next minister of justice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Agreed. I'll give you the seat if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. I'll give you the seat if we pass the vote."
entries.menuText: "Agreed. I'll give you the seat if we pass the vote."
